title: Scientific Claim & Benchmark Freeze
description: Establish immutable definitions for candidate quantum circuits, performance claims, adversarial refutation thresholds, and preregistered experimental protocols.

tasks.title: Claim Inventory
tasks.description: Formulate candidate quantum advantage claims QF-001 through QF-005 in independent epistemic states.

tasks.title: Benchmark Selection
tasks.description: Select DNA-Lang parameterized quantum circuit families and define depth/qubit configurations.

tasks.title: Metric Definition
tasks.description: Specify cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB) and coherent negentropy metric Xi with coverage constraints.

tasks.title: Refutation Criteria
tasks.description: Establish formal refutation conditions: classical reproduction under budget, or sample coverage C < 0.1.

tasks.title: Protocol Freeze
tasks.description: Publish immutable protocol manifest with pre-registered sha256 digests in SEP package.

exit_condition: CLAIM + PROTOCOL + ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA IMMUTABLY IDENTIFIED

title: Classical Attack Ladder
description: Implement and execute the 4-level adversarial classical simulation ladder to establish the classical boundary.

tasks.title: Exact Reference Baseline
tasks.description: Simulate exact statevector ground truth for small instances (M <= 24 qubits) via Qiskit Aer.

tasks.title: Tensor-Network Sweep
tasks.description: Execute Matrix Product State (MPS) simulations sweeping bond dimension chi in [16, 256].

tasks.title: Pauli-Path Campaign
tasks.description: Execute Pauli-path / Clifford+T hybrid expansion attacks targeting peaked circuit observables.

tasks.title: Heuristic Campaign
tasks.description: Run evolutionary and heuristic classical optimization searches guided by LivLM agent.

tasks.title: Resource Scaling Analysis
tasks.description: Measure runtime and memory consumption across classical attack families as problem size scales.

tasks.title: Adversarial Comparison
tasks.description: Evaluate candidate circuit fidelity against best classical attack; record boundary.

title: Operational Evidence & Execution Governance
description: Enforce runtime security, OSIRIS pre-adapter boundaries, cryptographic receipts, and cross-plane non-substitution.

tasks.title: Artifact Identity Pinning
tasks.description: Enforce strict SHA-256 content hashing for all source artifacts; reject mutable references.

tasks.title: Runtime Identity & Probing
tasks.description: Execute operational confinement probes (seccomp, egress, filesystem writes).

tasks.title: Execution Receipts Capture
tasks.description: Generate machine-readable RuntimeProbeReceipts for all operational assertions.

tasks.title: Resource Receipts Logging
tasks.description: Construct machine-readable resource accounting ledger for compute and memory consumption.

tasks.title: Operational Evidence Validation
tasks.description: Adjudicate S_deployed; record adverse-first failure if confinement violated.

exit_condition: OPERATIONAL EVIDENCE COMPLETE FOR DECLARED EXECUTION

title: Quantum Hardware Confrontation
description: Where justified by GATE-003, dispatch pre-registered circuits to physical QPUs (IBM Heron via BlueQubit API) and record raw telemetry.

tasks.title: Hardware Eligibility Gate Audit
tasks.description: Verify GATE-001 and GATE-002 pass before consuming any external QPU allocation.

tasks.title: QPU Manifest Freeze
tasks.description: Freeze exact transpiler seeds, shots, and circuit parameter vectors for physical submission.

tasks.title: Hardware Execution
tasks.description: Submit batch jobs to physical IBM Heron 156-qubit backend via BlueQubit API.

tasks.title: Raw Data Capture
tasks.description: Ingest complete unmitigated bitstring measurement counts and backend calibration hashes.

tasks.title: Provider Receipt Capture
tasks.description: Generate HardwareProviderReceipt binding provider job_id, calibration hash, and raw counts digest.

title: Independent Reproduction & Adjudication
description: Subject experimental outputs to clean-room rerun, alternative analysis pipelines, and adverse-first adjudication.

tasks.title: Independent Reproduction
tasks.description: Re-run analysis scripts from clean checkout on isolated environment without cached state.

tasks.title: Alternate Analysis Pipeline
tasks.description: Re-analyze raw bitstring counts with independent entropy estimators (Miller-Madow, Chao-Shen, NSB).

tasks.title: Adversarial Re-Test
tasks.description: Permit independent evaluator to inject additional classical attack parameters.

tasks.title: Discrepancy Resolution
tasks.description: Compare primary and reproduction outputs; record divergence if observed.

tasks.title: Final Adjudication
tasks.description: Issue definitive claim disposition: SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or INCONCLUSIVE.

title: Open Release & Publication
description: Publish complete reproducible code, manifests, research papers, and permanent DOI archival records.

tasks.title: Repository Preparation
tasks.description: Establish clean, version-controlled repository with automated governance test suite.

tasks.title: Evidence Package Assembly
tasks.description: Package OEP, SEP, and XPL evidence bundles with cryptographic manifests.

tasks.title: Reproducibility Package
tasks.description: Provide clean-room execution instructions, test harness, and dependency lockfiles.

tasks.title: Paper / Preprint Generation
tasks.description: Author research paper documenting architecture, estimator critique, and empirical findings.

tasks.title: Permanent DOI Archival
tasks.description: Archive release assets and proposal on Zenodo; mint persistent DOIs.

tasks.title: Release Verification
tasks.description: Tag release commit and verify public availability of assets and checksums.

exit_condition: OPEN ARTIFACTS AND VERIFIABLE RELEASE PUBLISHED
